name: @weavetab/plugin-github
description: Official Weavetab GitHub plugin. Analyze repository structure, read raw source files, search and inspect issues, and examine pull requests over the public GitHub REST API — fetched directly over HTTP, so no browser turns are consumed.

config.reason: Reads and persists the isolated plugin configuration (cache TTL, read limits, default issue limit) at ~/.weavetab/plugins/@weavetab_plugin-github/config.json.

cdp.reason: Reads the active tab URL only, to infer the target repository when the optional 'repo' argument is omitted. Never navigates or mutates the page.

network.reason: Fetches repository metadata, file trees, raw source files, issues and pull requests from the public GitHub REST API and raw content CDN.

tools.name: plugin_github
tools.description: Interact with GitHub repositories without burning browser turns. Analyze a repo's file tree and README, read raw source files, list/search/inspect issues, and examine pull request details, changed files and comments — all fetched over the GitHub REST API.

action.description: The GitHub operation to perform. 'analyze' = repository metadata, recursive file tree and README snippet. 'read' = raw file contents (requires 'paths'). 'issues' = list, search or inspect issues. 'pr' = list or inspect pull requests.

repo.description: Target repository as an 'owner/repo' slug or a full https://github.com/owner/repo URL. Optional — when omitted, the repository is inferred from the active browser tab (which must be on a github.com repo page).

paths.description: READ ONLY. File paths relative to the repository root to fetch (e.g. ['src/index.ts', 'README.md']).

line_range.description: READ ONLY. Optional [start, end] 1-indexed line range to return from each file. When omitted, files longer than 'maxReadLines' are truncated from the top.

number.description: ISSUES / PR ONLY. Issue or pull request number to fetch the full detail and comments for. When omitted, a recent list is returned instead.

search.description: ISSUES ONLY. Free-text search query to find issues (uses the GitHub Search API, scoped to the target repo).

labels.description: ISSUES ONLY. Restrict results to issues carrying all of the given labels.

state.description: ISSUES ONLY. Filter by issue state.

limit.description: ISSUES ONLY. Maximum number of issues to return when listing or searching (default 5).
